newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SEARCON TO DELIST IN SEARDEL UNBUNDLING.
newsitem.headline: SEARCON TO DELIST IN SEARDEL UNBUNDLING.

text.p: South African holding firm Seardel Consolidated Holdings Ltd (Searcon) is to be delisted as part of an unbundling of clothing and electronics group Seardel Investment Corp announced on Tuesday.

Searcon will distribute all the Seardel ordinary and "N" ordinary shares held by it to Searcon shareholders on the basis on one Seardel ordinary share for each Searcon ordinary share. The "N" shares will be distributed at the same ratio.
The group said the existence of two listed firms is causing unnecessary expense.
"The distribution will have the effect of collapsing the pyramid structure and affording Searcon shareholders a direct shareholding in Seardel," the firm said.
In separate announcements Seardel Investment Corp Ltd and Seartec Ltd both said they were reducing their share capital in lieu of a dividend.
